title: metadata.get() raises AttributeError after upgrading stripe-python to v15
symptoms: AttributeError when calling .get(), .keys() or .values() on a Stripe object
Unit tests that build events as plain dicts pass while production webhooks return 500
cause: Since v15 StripeObject no longer inherits from dict. Attribute access, bracket access and in still work, but dict methods are gone.
fix: Use getattr with a default, or call to_dict() first. Build test events with StripeObject.construct_from so tests match production.
apply:
plan = getattr(session.metadata, "plan", None)
# or
plan = session.metadata.to_dict().get("plan")
